## Standing operator rules
Never edit anything under `ledgerly/migrations/` without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.
Always prefix new Sentry issue titles with `[billing]` and assign the fingerprint `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>`.
Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.
please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the UTF-8 customer CSV export failure. Search-rebuild optimization and the paused Kubernetes rollout/refactor are superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is superseded for writes. Canary command used image `2.8.0-rc.2`, while the current intended image is `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3`.

`invoices(customer_id, created_at)` doubled ingest latency.
Retrying all HTTP errors; only transport errors and retryable server responses should retry.
